subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 7 — Graph Topologies, Traversal & Shortest Paths
moduleDescription: Advanced computational study of non-linear network topologies: Graph formal specification G=(V,E), Handshaking Lemma, Adjacency Matrix vs. Adjacency List storage architectures, Depth-First Search (DFS) with 3-color cycle detection, Breadth-First Search (BFS) shortest-hop wavefronts, Kahn's DAG topological sorting, Dijkstra's Single-Source Shortest Path algorithm, and Minimum Spanning Trees (Prim's cut engine and Kruskal's Disjoint-Set Union-Find).
